simple.meaning: חָסֵר (châçêr) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “lacking ; hence, without.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 19 times across 1 Samuel, 2 Samuel, 1 Kings, Proverbs, Ecclesiastes, beginning at 1 Samuel 21:16. Its contexts include family.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חָסֵר (H2638).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: חָסֵר (châçêr) / H2638 is traced through 1 Samuel 21:16, 2 Samuel 3:29, 1 Kings 11:22, 1 Kings 17:16 as a generated source-based concept entry.

timeline.evidenceText: Let it fall on the head of Joab, and on all his father’s house. Let there not fail from the house of Joab one who has a discharge, or who is a leper, or who leans on a staff, or who falls by the sword, or who lacks bread.”
Then Pharaoh said to him, “But what have you lacked with me, that behold, you seek to go to your own country?”
The jar of meal didn’t run out, and the jar of oil didn’t fail, according to Yahweh’s word, which he spoke by Elijah.
He who commits adultery with a woman is void of understanding.
I saw among the simple ones.
“Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!”
“Whoever is simple, let him turn in here.”
Wisdom is found on the lips of him who has discernment,
The lips of the righteous feed many,
One who despises his neighbor is void of wisdom,
Better is he who is little known, and has a servant,
He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread,
Folly is joy to one who is void of wisdom,
A man void of understanding strikes hands,
I went by the field of the sluggard,

a man to whom God gives riches, wealth, and honor, so that he lacks nothing for his soul of all that he desires, yet God gives him no power to eat of it, but an alien eats it. This is vanity, and it is an evil disease.
Yes also when the fool walks by the way, his understanding fails him, and he says to everyone that he is a fool.

definitions.full: H2638. chaser חָסֵר adjective needy, lacking, in want of — ׳ח absolute Eccl 6:2 ; construct חֲסַר 1 Samuel 21:16 13 t.; — needy, in want of ׳ח אני משׁגעים 1 Samuel 21:16 am I in want of madmen ? 2Sam 3:29 in need of bread , so Prov 12:9 ; usually חֲסַרלֵֿב lacking understanding, sense 6:32 ; 7:7 ; 9:4 , 16 ; 10:13 ; 11:12 ; 12:11 ; 15:21 ; ח לֵֿב׳אָדָם 17:18 ; 24:30 ; ח ׳נָּגִיד תְּבוּנוֺת 28:16 ; וג מִכֹּל ׳לְנַפְשׁוֺ חָסֵר אֵינֶנּוּ Eccl 6:2 neither is he lacking for his soul in aught of ( מן particle ) all that he desireth.
